title: viola tricolor var. carpatica
intro: Viola tricolor var. carpatica, commonly known as the Creeping Pansy or Johnny Jump-Up, is a flowering plant species in the violet family. It is used in herbal medicine to support the immune system and reduce inflammation, making it beneficial for various health issues, including colds, fever, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Viola tricolor var. carpatica include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe wounds and calm skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as rutin, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
